answer: Nairobi County allocated KES 12.4 billion to the Health Services sector in FY 2025/26 — about 21% of the total county budget. The largest share (KES 6.1B) goes to curative and rehabilitative health services, followed by preventive and promotive health (KES 4.3B).

sources.snippet: Health Services Sector — total allocation KES 12,400,000,000

answer: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Nairobi imetenga KES 3.8 bilioni kwa sekta ya maji na uondoaji wa maji taka katika mwaka wa fedha 2025/26. Kiasi kikubwa (KES 2.4B) kinaenda kwa ukarabati wa mifumo ya usambazaji wa maji.
